title: Appointed as Assistant
original: What's up, Doctor? Me, I'm just on standby.

title: Talk 1
original: My shield? Fun fact: I personally provide a portion of the energy it needs.

title: Talk 2
original: What I look like beneath the mask? Well, I... Actually, let's keep it secret for a bit longer.

title: Talk 3
original: Man, nothing better than a break after you finish a mission.

title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
original: Doctor, if I get to know you better, I figure my shield's gonna get even sturdier.

title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
original: Course I know where my limit's at. But I don't want Yato to worry about me, which is what matters. We'll worry about the rest some other time!

title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
original: There's always the need for guys like me, you know? Nah, I'm not trying to act high and mighty. What I'm saying is: when you have a VIP plus a lot of danger, you need a guy to stand between them, that's all.

title: Idle
original: Sometimes you've just gotta take off the mask and catch a breather.

title: Onboard
original: Defender Noir Corne, reporting for duty. You need VIP protection, I'm your guy.

title: Watching Battle Record
original: Cool... So this stuff is what Grandpa Rangers was talking about earlier.

title: Added to Squad
original: We bringing friends?

title: Appointed as Squad Leader
original: I'm gonna get even stronger!

title: Depart
original: Holding the line is a Defender's most important job!

title: Begin Operation
original: We're doing it!

title: Selecting Operator 1
original: C'mon, say something.

title: Selecting Operator 2
original: What's up?

title: Deployment 1
original: I've got this!

title: Deployment 2
original: Here I come!

title: In Battle 1
original: Watch it, buddy!

title: In Battle 2
original: Reinforce defenses!

title: 4-star Result
original: Even guys like me are happy to get through tough battles like these.

title: 3-star Result
original: That was all right.

title: Sub 3-star Result
original: Well, we managed.

title: Operation Failure
original: This wouldn't have happened if I'd worn my good mask! God dammit!

title: Assigned to Facility
original: Alright, let's take a breather.

title: Tap
original: Yeah?

title: Trust Tap
original: You wanna get some drinks after work?

title: Title
original: Arknights.

title: New Year's blessing
original: It's these kinds of days I love the most. Everyone has a blast getting together, and we're off work. C'mon, Doctor, you gotta try this burdenbeast offal flambé while it's still fresh from the pan! Whoa, whoa, I don't think Dr. Kal'tsit's gonna like you drinking that much, y'know?

title: Greeting
original: Nothing outta the ordinary, Doctor.

title: Birthday
original: Yo, Doctor! Here's a mask from my stash, straight to you! You've rocked the hood for long enough, right? You could try masking up, just for today. Think about it! And hey, if no one else is gonna say it, I will—I think you'll look cool as hell with it on.

title: Anniversary Celebration
original: With all the years I've spent at Rhodes Island, I know exactly what's left on the agenda today. The Doctor's still got mad business, alright? Can't keep 'em any longer. Everyone, a toast to the Doctor, who's spent another year working hard for us! To you!
